note: Lean proves only |δ| m ≤ x/2, i.e. x/m ≥ 2|δ|, and not the text's stronger x/m ≥ 2|δ|q.

have hMδ : |δ| * M ≤ x / 2 := by
    have h1 : |δ| * M ≤ |δ| * (Q / 2) := by
      rw [hMQ]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_left _ _) (abs_nonneg _)
    have h2 : |δ| * (q * Q) ≤ x := by
      have e : |δ / x| * (q * Q) = |δ| * (q * Q) / x := by rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hx]; ring
      rw [e, div_le_one hx] at hδ; exact hδ
    have h3 : |δ| * Q ≤ x := by
      have : |δ| * Q ≤ |δ| * (q * Q) := by
        have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := by linarith
        have : Q ≤ q * Q := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ q by exact_mod_cast hq)) hQ0]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (abs_nonneg _)
      linarith
    linarith

proof_context.conclusion: `|δ|·M ≤ x/2`, from `M ≤ Q/2` and `|δ/x| q Q ≤ 1`.

· have hr : |δ * (q * m' : ℕ) / x| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        have hm'N : (m' : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast h.2
        rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hx, Nat.abs_cast, div_le_iff₀ hx]
        push_cast
        have : (q : ℝ) * m' ≤ M := by
          calc (q : ℝ) * m' ≤ q * (M / q) := by gcongr; linarith
            _ = M := by field_simp
        calc |δ| * (q * m') ≤ |δ| * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (abs_nonneg _)
          _ ≤ 1 / 2 * x := by linarith

set C : ℝ := m / x * (c₀ / (2 * π ^ 2))
  have hρ : |ρ| ≤ 1 / 2 := by simpa [ρ, hmdef] using hr
  have hkρ : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → (k : ℝ) - ρ ≠ 0 := by
    intro k hk h0
    have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(k : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hk
    have : (k : ℝ) = ρ := by linarith
    rw [this] at hk1; linarith
  have hbound : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → ‖𝓕 h k‖ ≤ C * (1 / ((k : ℝ) - ρ) ^ 2) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hF k, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_e, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    have ht : (k : ℝ) * x / (2 * m) - δ / 2 = x / (2 * m) * ((k : ℝ) - ρ) := by
      simp only [ρ]; field_simp
    have hne : (k : ℝ) * x / (2 * m) - δ / 2 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [ht]; exact mul_ne_zero (by positivity) (hkρ k hk)
    refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_eta2hat_le _ hne) (by positivity)).trans
      (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [ht]; simp only [C]
    have := hkρ k hk
    field_simp
  obtain ⟨hs, hsle⟩ := tsum_inv_sq_sub_le hρ

proof_context.conclusion: For `k ≠ 0`, `‖𝓕h k‖ ≤ C/(k - ρ)²` with `ρ = δm/x`, `|ρ| ≤ 1/2`, and `∑_{k≠0} 1/(k-ρ)² ` is bounded by `tsum_inv_sq_sub_le`.

proof.summary: From M <= Q/2 and |delta/x| q Q <= 1 the shift rho = delta m/x satisfies |rho| <= 1/2, and `Todd_main` then bounds the nonzero frequencies by an inverse-square sum.
